Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Got questions? We’ve got answers. Here are some common queries about our inverter AC repair service.

How much does inverter AC repair cost in Vadodara?

The cost for an inverter AC repair service in Vadodara varies. A basic inspection starts from ₹299. However, the final price depends on the specific issue, parts required (like PCB, compressor, or gas), and the brand of your AC. At Atlas Aircon, we provide a transparent quote before starting any work.

What is the price for inverter AC PCB repair?

The inverter AC PCB repair price can range from ₹1,500 to ₹7,500+, depending on the complexity of the board and the specific brand. Minor component repairs are cheaper, while a full board replacement is more expensive. We always aim to repair the existing PCB to save you money.

Do you offer a warranty on your repair services?

Yes, absolutely! We stand by our work. Atlas Aircon provides a 3-month guarantee on all our inverter AC repair services and any parts we replace. This gives you peace of mind knowing the job is done right.

How quickly can a technician reach my home in Vadodara?

We offer emergency inverter AC repair in Vadodara. Our goal is to have a certified technician at your doorstep within 60-90 minutes of your call, anywhere in the Vadodara region.

My inverter AC is not cooling. What could be the problem?

An inverter AC not cooling can be due to several reasons: low refrigerant (gas), a dirty filter or condenser coil, a faulty compressor, or a malfunctioning PCB or sensor. Our technicians can quickly diagnose and fix the exact issue.

Is a dual inverter AC different to repair?

Yes, slightly. A dual inverter AC has a more advanced compressor. Our technicians are experts in dual inverter AC repair Vadodara and understand the specific nuances of these systems.
